name: switchboard-monorepo
description: Switchboard: your bots, any model, every channel, approved from your pocket.

scripts.build: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/desktop
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
